QuestionStmt.S: Which from following formulae is used to obtain value of $E_{\text{cell}}^\circ$ for a reaction taking place in Dry cell?

Solution.S:
The relationship between standard Gibbs free energy change and standard cell potential is:

$$\Delta G^\circ = -nF E_{\text{cell}}^\circ$$

Rearranging:

$$E_{\text{cell}}^\circ = -\frac{\Delta G^\circ}{nF}$$

In a dry cell (Leclanché cell), the overall cell reaction involves the transfer of 2 electrons. Therefore, $n = 2$.

Thus the correct formula is:

$$E_{\text{cell}}^\circ = -\frac{\Delta G^\circ}{2F}$$

This corresponds to option B.
